outcome_access_statement.honest_label: Definitions were completed after v2 label execution began, without observing its outcomes. This is exploratory prespecification before the supplement own run, not a global pre-label or fresh confirmatory freeze.
outcome_access_statement.scope_decision: Root requested assessment of all ten remaining ideas before v2 first-label execution; this final freeze is later.

shared_framework.final_period_label: Chronological evaluation, partly previously observed; not an untouched holdout.
shared_framework.bar_formula: r[k]=ln(C[k]/O[k]); within-bar log returns. Signal bars aggregate complete native1m bars anchored 09:30 America/New_York; correct session calendar, DST and early close.
shared_framework.eligibility: All arms require current plus nine prior complete signal bars within the same RTH session. H139 requires sixteen prior bars instead; H144 additionally requires sixty complete native1m bars immediately BEFORE current signal-bar start. Use max(default history, family history); no cross-session histories or partial windows.
shared_framework.entry: A bar ending t skips [t,t+1m); exact native1m open at t+1m is entry. Exit at exact native1m open entry+h minutes. Both strictly before same-session close. No forward scan.
shared_framework.quality: Use unchanged sealed v2 data-quality rules: complete RTH sessions, matching source hashes, positive finite ordered OHLC, nonnegative integer volume, unique expected minute grid, no interpolation, no negative-volume clamping. Missing inputs/labels are UNKNOWN, not cash.
shared_framework.states: Candidate and each fixed baseline have independent non-overlap state per ticker/policy. New entry at previous exit is allowed. Sides separate, no pyramiding.
shared_framework.economics: Per-trade s*(exit/entry-1)-cost_bps/10000. Equal1/9 fixed symbol sleeves; unused slots cash without redistributing missing capital. Same constant-notional daily proxy and risk metrics as v2; stock price proxies, not executable option or short-borrow claims.
shared_framework.statistical_conventions: Natural logs; Pearson correlation; sample SD ddof1; exact zeros/threshold equality handled as specified; finite checks everywhere. Sign(0)=0. No clipping or epsilon signal thresholds.
shared_framework.information_intervals: Retain actual earliest input start and latest exit/availability for every candidate/baseline. For H139 feature_start=start[k-16]. For H144 include its full sixty-minute prior raw window and the default warm-up. Perform actual interval purge; do not reuse v2 maximum-lookback shorthand.
shared_framework.inference: Same whole-session paired evaluation, expanding April–September development folds, no outcome-based fitting, 5-session moving-block bootstrap with10-session sensitivity,10000 resamples seed150,99% simultaneous one-sided lower bounds, minimum60 complete day clusters, UNKNOWN coverage retained. Jointly resample date×symbol×policy vectors.
shared_framework.calendar_caveat: For calendar arms report the number of distinct active calendar-event days in addition to all available days. Do not count repeated intraday trades or zero-exposure days as independent event replication. Sparse event histories remain descriptive/insufficient-sample regardless of raw trade count.
shared_framework.multiplicity: The 126 supplement contrasts append to the 54 v2 contrasts, giving180 registered primary5bps contrasts if presented together. Include all in joint selection correction; other costs, diagnostics and historical studies remain disclosed. Effective trial count remains unknown; DSR cannot become a pass from this registration.
shared_framework.promotion: No live signal promotion. Existing allowed outcomes: BLOCKED_DATA, DESCRIPTIVE_ONLY, INSUFFICIENT_SAMPLE, REJECTED_AFTER_COSTS, CANDIDATE_FOR_NEW_FORWARD_PAPER. The current short final period cannot receive a confirmation pass.

families.feature_formula: M_s(k) = [s*ln(C[k]/C[k-3]) > 0] AND [s*r[k] > 0]. E(d)=1 iff d is one of the last two official US regular trading dates in the FULL calendar month containing d.
invalid_rules: Missing OHLCV or default warm-up makes every arm ineligible. Calendar classification cannot use the last two dates in the downloaded subset.
limitations: Measures a last-two-session momentum filter; does not identify fund rebalancing orders or establish that rebalancing caused returns.
Baseline comparison changes exposure and turnover; improvement may reflect cash or fewer costs. It cannot alone identify a calendar-specific edge.

families.feature_formula: B(d)=1 iff d is one of the first two official US regular trading dates in the FULL calendar month containing d.

side_interpretation.short: Prespecified falsification diagnostic only. A successful short arm contradicts the stated positive tendency and cannot be relabelled support or promoted under this claim.

families.original_text_exact: Kayan pencerede Hurst üssü > 0.55 iken trend takip, < 0.45 iken ortalamaya dönüş algoritmasını aktif etme.
feature_formula: x = r[k-16:k], exactly 16 prior completed signal-bar within-bar log returns, oldest first; exclude current r[k].
For each m in {4,8,16}, partition x into all consecutive non-overlapping blocks of m, beginning at x[0]; block counts are 4,2,1.
For a block b: mean_b=mean(b), Z[0]=0, Z[j]=sum_{i=1..j}(b[i]-mean_b), R_b=max(Z)-min(Z), S_b=sample_sd(b,ddof=1).
Q_m = arithmetic mean of R_b/S_b across EVERY block at that scale. Every block must have finite S_b>0 and R_b>0. Any invalid block makes candidate AND both baselines ineligible; do not omit blocks.
For a_m=ln(m), y_m=ln(Q_m), H_RS = sum((a_m-mean(a))*(y_m-mean(y)))/sum((a_m-mean(a))^2), the OLS slope with intercept across the three scales. No clipping or fitted correction.
d(k)=sign(r[k]) if H_RS>0.55; d(k)=-sign(r[k]) if H_RS<0.45; otherwise d(k)=0. Equality at either threshold means cash; r[k]=0 means cash.
invalid_rules: At least sixteen prior complete bars plus current bar in the same RTH session. Both fixed baselines use exactly the same estimator-valid roster.
limitations: Original thresholds 0.55 and 0.45 are retained, but the 16-return, three-scale R/S estimator and base direction rule are newly declared conventions.
This tiny-window R/S proxy is biased and uncertain; it does not establish a true Hurst exponent, persistence, long memory, or a market regime. No threshold calibration is performed.
Both baseline contrasts must be shown; never choose the better-looking baseline after results.

families.original_text_exact: 15 dakikalık getirilerin 1. gecikmeli otokorelasyonu pozitifken momentum, negatifken contrarian çalışma.
families.feature_formula: rho(k)=Pearson(r[k-9:k-1], r[k-8:k]), exactly eight overlapping lag-1 pairs from the nine PRIOR completed signal-bar returns. d(k)=sign(rho(k))*sign(r[k]).
invalid_rules: Either lag array with zero/nonfinite variance makes every arm ineligible. Exactly zero rho or current return gives candidate cash, not a missing observation. All arms share the same valid prior-feature roster.
limitations: The source explicitly specifies 15-minute returns. The 1m and 5m versions are separately registered timeframe adaptations, not replications of that wording.
Rolling window length, within-bar return convention and current-return direction rule were absent from the original and are fixed here without outcome access.
Both baseline contrasts must be reported.

families.original_text_exact: 1 dakikalık getirilerin pozitif kuyruk (en iyi %5) ve negatif kuyruk (en kötü %5) asimetrisinin yön belirlemesi.
feature_formula: Let a=start_time[k] of the CURRENT signal bar, not its end. Take exactly the 60 contiguous native 1m bars with start_time in [a-60 minutes,a), within the current RTH session. The whole current signal bar is excluded.
For each native minute j, u[j]=ln(close[j]/open[j]). Sort all 60 u ascending, retaining ties. L=mean(sorted_u[0:3]); U=mean(sorted_u[57:60]), exactly the bottom and top 5%.
If U>L, T=(U+L)/(U-L). Candidate direction is sign(T). No clipping; T may lie outside [-1,1] when both ranked tails have the same sign.

baselines.formula: TRUE on the same valid-tail feature roster; same side s.

invalid_rules: U<=L or any missing/nonfinite required minute makes every arm ineligible. Preserve the v2 minimum nine prior signal bars in addition to the sixty prior native minutes.
limitations: Call this signed top/bottom-3-of-60 tail balance, not a conditional positive-versus-negative tail estimator; the worst three observations can still be positive.
Every cadence uses native 1m tails, preserving the source return granularity. 5m and 15m change only decision cadence, not tail sampling.
Window length, normalization and sign mapping are operational choices absent from the source.

nonexecuted_remaining.original_text_exact: Her tam saatin ilk 2 dakikasında kurumsal TWAP/VWAP algoritmalarının devreye girmesiyle oluşan periyodik hacim sıçramaları.
nonexecuted_remaining.source_section: 5. BIST VIOP Seans ve Saat İçi Mevsimsellik
nonexecuted_remaining.exact_observable_proposal: For each local full hour H=10:00,...,15:00 with complete native minutes, D_H=ln(1+V[H]+V[H+1m])-ln(1+V[H-2m]+V[H-1m]). Aggregate within ticker/day and then across the fixed nine sleeves; compare paired two-minute volume windows descriptively.
nonexecuted_remaining.why_no_trade_rule: The original predicts volume periodicity, not a long/short return. OHLCV cannot identify institutional TWAP/VWAP actors. Assigning a direction, 1/5/15m holding policy, or using 5m/15m bars to recover the exact first two minutes would introduce a new hypothesis. This descriptive formula is not registered for execution in S1.

A new fixed-hold contrarian US rule could set direction=-sign(g), with a same-clock unconditional baseline.

Do not assume S=1,D=0 or compare stale last-available closes across missing sessions. Source describes whole-session overnight/intraday decomposition; 1/5/15m fixed holds would additionally be an explicit new horizon adaptation.

nonexecuted_remaining.calendar_definition: Long holiday reopening means the previous official regular session is at least four calendar days earlier, with at least one scheduled weekday exchange holiday in between.
